selection: Six candidates frozen before first v2 run. No parameter tuning after screening. All candidates, failures and robustness results saved.
risk_initialization: EWMA daily squared returns starts at annual risk 20%, at each fresh entry. No price direction, expected return, valuation or future volatility input.
parameter_rationale: Half/three-quarter participation; 10%/20% annual risk levels; 63 trading days is one quarter. These are predetermined risk preferences and horizons, not data-estimated optima.
execution: Monthly first available trading day open, signals from previous available close only. Initial allocation predetermined. One-extra-session delay and daily execution are separate stress checks.
basket: Same initially equal-dollar fixed-share total-return basket as previous comparator; no constituent selection or relative-weight optimization.
decision: Universal candidate must match a solvent fixed-leverage comparator and not have worse drawdown on every asset/basket in every required segment. No unmatched segment is counted as a pass. Report primary/full criteria separately as well.
stress_checks: For primary and full-history: 20bp fee, one extra trading-session signal delay, daily execution. Parameter neighbors are diagnostics, never alternate selections: alpha +/-0.05; risk target +/-20%; EWMA half-life 32 and 126.
no_iteration: After this six-candidate batch, no threshold, timing or parameter is changed in response to failures. Any further attempt must be a new version with its full trial history.
scope: Retrospective anti-overfit safeguards, not untouched out-of-sample evidence. Cached surviving technology assets remain a narrow universe. No promised guarantee of equal-return drawdown superiority on arbitrary price paths.
